name: WhyKnot
tagline: Shows restaurant owners what dishes sell and at what price near a location, from delivery data.
problem: Restaurants guess menus and prices when opening or expanding.
solution: Transaction data from delivery orders becomes heatmaps and analysis by location, with an AI advisor for menus.
demo_moment: Team-described: search a neighbourhood and see top-selling dishes and prices.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best .Tech Domain Name by MLH” among 195 submissions.
Turns consumer transaction data into owner insight.

lessons: Data-access sponsors reward a clear buyer for the data.
